% Independent Tectonic observations for global definitions and group restoration.
\documentclass{article}
\def\a{OLD}
\begingroup
  \def\a{OUTER}
  \begingroup
    \def\a{INNER}\gdef\a{GLOBAL}\def\a{LOCAL}
    \xdef\inside{\a}
  \endgroup
  \xdef\middle{\a}
\endgroup
\edef\after{\a}
\typeout{PYTEXML inside=\meaning\inside}
\typeout{PYTEXML middle=\meaning\middle}
\typeout{PYTEXML after=\meaning\after}
\def\b{OTHER}
{\def\b{LOCAL}\gdef\a{G}\let\a\b}
\typeout{PYTEXML a=\meaning\a}
\typeout{PYTEXML b=\meaning\b}
{\gdef\fresh{FIRST}{\gdef\fresh{LAST}\def\fresh{LOCAL}}\def\fresh{OUTER}}
\typeout{PYTEXML fresh=\meaning\fresh}
\def\old{OLD}
{\def\old{LOCAL}\xdef\old{\old NEW}}
\typeout{PYTEXML expanded=\meaning\old}
\let\savedglobal\gdef
\def\gdef{SHADOW}
{\savedglobal\copied{COPIED}}
\typeout{PYTEXML copied=\meaning\copied}
\let\gdef\savedglobal
\begingroup
  \catcode`\_=12 \gdef\under{_}
\endgroup
\typeout{PYTEXML under=\meaning\under}
\typeout{PYTEXML underscore_after=\the\catcode`\_}
\ifcat\under?\typeout{PYTEXML underscore_token=other}\else\typeout{PYTEXML underscore_token=wrong}\fi
\begingroup
  \catcode`\(=1 \catcode`\)=2 \catcode`\{=12 \catcode`\}=12
  \gdef\leftchar({)\gdef\rightchar(})
\endgroup
\typeout{PYTEXML left=\meaning\leftchar}
\typeout{PYTEXML right=\meaning\rightchar}
\ifcat\leftchar?\typeout{PYTEXML left_token=other}\else\typeout{PYTEXML left_token=wrong}\fi
\ifcat\rightchar?\typeout{PYTEXML right_token=other}\else\typeout{PYTEXML right_token=wrong}\fi
\typeout{PYTEXML brace_after=\the\catcode`\{}
\begingroup
  \catcode`\!=13 \gdef!{ACTIVE}
\endgroup
\def\!{SYMBOL}
{\catcode`\!=13 \typeout{PYTEXML active=\meaning!}}
\typeout{PYTEXML symbol=\meaning\!}
\typeout{PYTEXML exclamation_after=\the\catcode`\!}
\begin{document}
Global definition witness.
\end{document}
